verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a product-management SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no scheduler or recurring workflow feature. The cited automation is either event-driven (webhooks) or triggered on demand by an agent through the MCP server. The phrase "reschedule an initiative" means changing roadmap timing, not running a job on a schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
